nodes.summary: There are a Fitting class $\mathfrak{X}$ of finite groups that contains at least one finite group and a finite non-soluble group $G$ such that no subgroup of $G$ is an $\mathfrak{X}$-injector of $G$.
nodes.title: A Fitting class with no injectors in a non-soluble group

nodes.summary: The statement that there are a Fitting class $\mathfrak{X}$ of finite groups that contains at least one finite group and a finite non-soluble group $G$ such that no subgroup of $G$ is an $\mathfrak{X}$-injector of $G$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 12.96: a Fitting class without injectors

nodes.summary: A class of groups is a property of groups that is closed under isomorphism: if a group $H$ has the property and $K$ is a group isomorphic to $H$, then $K$ has it too.
nodes.title: Isomorphism-closed classes of groups (Kourovka 12.96)

nodes.summary: A class $\mathfrak{X}$ of groups is a Fitting class of finite groups if, for every finite group $G$, every normal subgroup of $G$ lies in $\mathfrak{X}$ whenever $G$ does, and the product $N_1 N_2$ of two normal subgroups $N_1$ and $N_2$ of $G$ lies in $\mathfrak{X}$ whenever $N_1$ and $N_2$ do.
nodes.title: Fitting classes of finite groups

nodes.summary: Let $\mathfrak{X}$ be a class of groups and $G$ a group. A subgroup $V$ of $G$ is an $\mathfrak{X}$-injector of $G$ if, for every subnormal subgroup $N$ of $G$, the intersection $V \cap N$ is $\mathfrak{X}$-maximal in $N$.
nodes.title: Injectors

nodes.summary: Let $\mathfrak{X}$ be a class of groups and let $V$ and $K$ be subgroups of a group $G$. Then $V$ is $\mathfrak{X}$-maximal in $K$ if $V \le K$, $V$ lies in $\mathfrak{X}$, and no subgroup $W$ of $G$ with $V < W \le K$ lies in $\mathfrak{X}$.
nodes.title: Maximal subgroups within a class of groups
